title: 第15章 里昂骑士第16章 再次出征
slug: 你好是寄往魔神堡垒的信吗
lines: 阴冷潮湿的地牢中，空气弥漫着腐朽的稻草和淡淡的血腥味。
石壁上昏暗的油灯摇曳，投下扭曲晃动的阴影。
林鬼被粗暴地推入一间狭窄的牢房，铁门在身后哐当一声锁死。
他稳住身形，目光迅速扫过隔壁。
希娅正抱膝坐在角落的干草堆上，听到动静抬起头。
她银白的发丝在昏暗光线下依旧显眼，红色的瞳孔中带着几分显而易见的郁闷。
但看起来并未受伤，只是精神有些萎靡。
当她看清来人是林鬼时，那双眸子瞬间瞪大了。
她猛地站起身，冲到栅栏边。
声音带着难以置信和一丝不易察觉的慌乱。
“你怎么会在这里？！你不是应该已经......“
她的话戛然而止，随即像是明白了什么，脸上瞬间被愤怒席卷。
她猛地扭头，看向牢房外，那两个全身覆甲的守卫。
声音因愤怒而拔高。
属于超凡强者的气势不受控制地溢散出一丝。
让牢房的空气都为之一凝。
“你们抓他干什么？！这件事和他一点关系都没有！他只是一个送信的！“
几乎在希娅气势迸发的同一瞬间，那两名沉默的守卫也猛地踏前一步！
两股更为沉凝、更具压迫力的气息骤然升起。
如同无形的巨石，精准而强硬地将希娅的气势硬生生压了回去！
希娅闷哼一声，身体微晃，被迫后退了半步。
她脸上闪过一丝惊疑不定，目光锐利地在那两名守卫身上扫过。
这两个人......
她从未在卡兰城中见过，实力绝对达到了超凡阶。
而且配合默契，绝非普通城卫军！
城主从哪里找来的这样的高手？
林鬼将这一幕尽收眼底，眼神微不可察地动了一下。
但脸上却露出一个轻松的笑容，仿佛没感受到，刚才那电光火石间的交锋。
他走到栅栏边，对着隔壁的希娅摆了摆手。
“哟，又见面了，希娅，看来我们还挺有缘分的，牢房都能做邻居。“
希娅却没心思开玩笑，她急切地压低声音。
“你傻吗？为什么不走？他们明显是冲着我来的！你掺和进来只会被牵连！“
“我也想走啊，谁知道才送完最后一封信，就被请来这里。“
林鬼耸耸肩，语气随意。
目光却越过希娅，若有所思地瞥了眼那两名守卫。
就在这时，一阵略显嘈杂的脚步声从地牢入口处传来。
城主在一群人的簇拥下走了进来。
content_en:
In the cold and damp dungeon, the air was filled with rotten straw and the faint smell of blood.
The dim oil lamp on the stone wall swayed, casting twisted and swaying shadows.
Lin Gui was roughly pushed into a narrow cell, and the iron door clanged shut behind him.
He stabilized his body and quickly glanced at the next door.
Sia was sitting on the haystack in the corner with her knees folded, and she raised her head when she heard the noise.
Her silver hair was still eye-catching in the dim light, and there was a hint of obvious depression in her red pupils.
But he didn't look injured, just a little depressed.
When she saw clearly that the person coming was Lin Gui, her eyes widened instantly.
"Lin Gui?!"
She stood up suddenly and rushed to the fence.
The voice was filled with disbelief and a trace of imperceptible panic.
"Why are you here?! Shouldn't you already be..."
Her words stopped suddenly, and then she seemed to understand something, and her face was instantly swept by anger.
She turned her head sharply and looked at the two guards covered in armor outside the cell.
The voice rose with anger.
The aura of an extraordinary powerful person spread out uncontrollably.
Let the air in the cell freeze.
"Why are you arresting him?! This matter has nothing to do with him! He is just a messenger!"
Almost at the same moment when Xia's momentum burst out, the two silent guards also took a sudden step forward!
Two more concentrated and oppressive breaths suddenly rose.
Like an invisible boulder, it accurately and forcefully suppressed Sia's momentum!
Xia groaned, her body swayed slightly, and she was forced to take half a step back.
A trace of surprise and uncertainty flashed across her face, and she glanced sharply at the two guards.
These two people...
She has never seen him in Kalan City before, and his strength has definitely reached the extraordinary level.
And they cooperate with each other tacitly, they are no ordinary city guards!
Where did the city lord find such a master?
Lin Gui took in all this scene and his eyes moved imperceptibly.
But there was a relaxed smile on his face, as if he didn't feel the electric confrontation just now.
He walked to the fence and waved to Sia next door.
"Hey, we meet again, Shia. It seems that we are quite destined. We can be neighbors in the prison cells."
Sia was not in the mood to joke, she lowered her voice eagerly.
"Are you stupid? Why don't you leave? They are obviously coming for me! If you get involved, you will only be implicated!"
"I want to leave too. Who knew I would be invited here just after sending the last letter."
Lin Gui shrugged, his tone casual.
But he looked past Sia and glanced at the two guards thoughtfully.
At this moment, a slightly noisy sound of footsteps came from the entrance of the dungeon.
The city lord walked in surrounded by a group of people.
